name: BrushController
definition: A CPU-side controller for voxel painting and erasing that uses DDA raycasting to determine brush position and normal on the voxel grid, with a fallback to ray-AABB intersection if voxel data is unavailable.
summary: BrushController is a CPU-side controller for interactive voxel painting and erasing that uses DDA raycasting to determine brush position and surface normal on a voxel grid.
